rows.text: You stroll alongside a blue lagoon, pass through a garden full of hoary stocks, and go around a hall of ivory and white stones. You walk up a grand golden staircase... and stop in front of the "IPC Branch Bank" sign.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: Every piece of ornament here is posh and dazzling... You walk up to the counter.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: "The more you deposit, the higher the interest rate." The teller has an infectious smile and an elegant demeanor. You believe he is an excellent employee trained by the Talent Motivation Department of the IPC.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe
